desc: Ideation complete: use complement reduction r = min(K, N-K) and enumerate at most 10^6 subsets.
Implement fast input parsing, total_xor computation, and r = min(K, N-K) mode selection.
Handle edge cases cleanly: r = 0 (answer total_xor), r = 1 (max(A) if K == 1, else max(total_xor ^ a)).
Implement general r-combination enumeration with direct or incremental XOR and update the best answer for chosen/excluded mode.
Verify correctness and performance on samples and edge cases: K = N, K = 1, K = N-1, duplicates, and maximum allowed number of combinations.
